intro: Equatorial Guinea is ruled by Teodoro Obiang, in power since 1979.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president holds almost all power, and elections are not considered free. His son Teodoro Nguema Obiang Mangue is vice president.

chapters.title: Rights
text: Rights groups criticise corruption and repression.

keyTerms.meaning: A system where power is concentrated.
